name: io.github.slfguardian/slf-guardian-mcp
title: SLF Guardian MCP
description: Pre-action checks for code, packages, prompts, commands, domains and passive site scans.

environmentVariables.name: SLF_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Recommended normal mode: SLF Guardian API key (slf_live_...). 1,000 free calls; create via POST https://slfguardian.com/v1/keys. Optional only when x402 auto-pay is explicitly enabled.

environmentVariables.name: SLF_X402_AUTO_PAY
environmentVariables.description: Optional buyer-side payment mode. Must be exactly true; used only when SLF_API_KEY is absent.

environmentVariables.name: SLF_X402_MAX_DAILY_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Optional local daily spend reservation cap in USDC; default 0.10. Keep the state directory private and persistent.

environmentVariables.name: CDP_API_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Customer's CDP API key id; required only for explicitly enabled x402 buyer mode. Store in a local secret manager.

environmentVariables.name: CDP_API_KEY_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Customer's CDP API key secret; required only for explicitly enabled x402 buyer mode. Store in a local secret manager.

environmentVariables.name: CDP_WALLET_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Customer's CDP wallet secret; required only for explicitly enabled x402 buyer mode. Store in a local secret manager.
